subject: RRO 8.0.1 error: "the process has forked and you cannot use this corefoundation functionality..."

messages.author: cce19e1de16efdda
messages.subject: RRO 8.0.1 error: "the process has forked and you cannot use this corefoundation functionality..."
parts:
Hi there, 

I work on a mac 10.9.5 and I upgraded to RRO 8.0.1 (which I see now that is "temporarily unavailable"). From there in advance I started to have a series of problems, getting many error messages (mainly not finding *.h libraries) when installing packages, but more importantly, this error message almost every time I ran algorithms like randomForest or boosted trees using the "caret" package: 

The process has forked and you cannot use this CoreFoundation functionality safely. You MUST exec().
Break on __THE_PROCESS_HAS_FORKED_AND_YOU_CANNOT_USE_THIS_COREFOUNDATION_FUNCTIONALITY___YOU_MUST_EXEC__() to debug.

I tried to uninstall RRO and go back to the previous version but the error was still there. It is important to mention that I did not get this error with the previous version of RRO or with CRAN R 3.1.2. Eventually, I had to completely uninstall RRO and go back to CRAN R 3.1.2 and everything works now. 

I am not sure whether this error is directly related to RRO, but the facts are: 
1-it did not happen with CRAN R 3.1.2
2-it did not happen with RRO 8.0
3-it happened when upgrading to RRO 8.0.1
4-it is not happening when going back to CRAN R 3.1.2

Hope RRO people find this useful :)

Regards

Javier
